scope: MEAS: independent numerical, published bar-map, provenance and visual review; not aural review.

defects.problem: The score and sheet are published, but the inspected report has no per-piece heading for this id.
defects.fix: Append a bach-cello-suite-1-prelude section recording the Schirmer 1916 / Andreas Scherer / Mutopia 517 public-domain source, unrepeated 42-bar Prelude and original cello-octave wrapper, final primary median 0.05591836734693345 s and P95 0.30997278911565046 s, maximum endpoint/middle deviation 0.04612244897960238 s, maximum local-region median 0.04036281179138257 s, zero collapses/invalid durations, 656 notes in one cello voice, 2 sheet pages / 42 bars, rejected late opening anchor and corrected 0.54 s first attack, and provisional/no-aural-review limits. Do not change the passing published notes to address this documentation defect.

barMap.finding: Published score traverses 1–42 once. Both engraved pages were inspected; the SVG data-bar identities equal index.json, all note bar/voice indices resolve, and bar times strictly increase. Listen cues use seconds; their prose bar-22 fermata and bars-37–42 close agree with the selected notation without claiming exact cue timing.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. The corrected first G2 begins near 0.54 s rather than a later repeated G; the bar-22 D4 hold around 61.1–62.36 s and final G-major chord near 123.04 s correspond to visible pitched energy. Bow changes and acoustic releases are not established.

version.finding: Complete Prelude only, unrepeated 42-bar traversal for unaccompanied cello; neither the remaining suite movements nor the separately supplied viola arrangement is substituted. Original source transpose c c, is applied once to extraction and engraving; visible register and published source inventory agree. No gross cut or arrangement mismatch identified in the inspected material.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the identified Schirmer edition is the symbolic source, not claimed as John Michel’s performing copy.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. The provisional label must remain.
